name: Skymark Airlines Inc.
summary: Skymark Airlines Inc. provides scheduled and non-scheduled air transportation services in Japan. It also offers services, including seating, seat assignment, baggage checking, and drink services and in-flight sales. In addition, the company provides support at the airport and on board for elderly, disabled, and injured customers, as well as children. Further, it engages in the passenger transportation related, and adverting and promotion businesses; and training equipment rental business, which includes flight simulators and aircraft ground handling vehicles. Skymark Airlines Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.
